SELECT f.week_ending_date, s.region, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT (f.store_key, f.product_key)) AS dist_keys, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores, min(f.etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, max(f.etl_loaded_at) AS max_load, sum(f.closing_value) AS val, sum(CASE WHEN f.closing_units<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg_units
FROM fact_stock_week f LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-23' AND DATE '2026-03-22'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH d AS (
 SELECT store_key, product_key, week_ending_date, count(*) c, count(DISTINCT closing_units) du, count(DISTINCT closing_value) dv, count(DISTINCT receipts_units) dr, count(DISTINCT adjustment_units) da
 FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-23' AND DATE '2026-03-22' GROUP BY ALL HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT count(*) AS dup_keys, max(c), max(du), max(dv), max(dr), max(da), min(store_key), max(store_key), min(week_ending_date), max(week_ending_date) FROM d

calls.statement:
WITH st AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT f.store_key, f.product_key, f.week_ending_date, f.closing_units, f.closing_value
 FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE s.region='West' AND f.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-23' AND DATE '2026-03-22')
SELECT p.category, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT st.week_ending_date) AS wks, count(DISTINCT p.sku) AS skus, sum(st.closing_value)/4 AS avg_val, sum(CASE WHEN p.product_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unmatched,
 sum(abs(st.closing_value - st.closing_units*p.standard_unit_cost)) AS valdiff
FROM st LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=st.product_key GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

WITH st AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT f.store_key, f.product_key, f.week_ending_date
 FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE s.region='West' AND f.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-23' AND DATE '2026-03-22'),
j AS (SELECT st.*, p.sku, p.valid_from, p.valid_to FROM st JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=st.product_key),
multi AS (SELECT store_key, sku, week_ending_date, count(*) c FROM j GROUP BY ALL HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM multi) AS multi_key_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM j WHERE week_ending_date NOT BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to) AS outside_validity, (SELECT count(*) FROM j) AS total_rows

WITH stock AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.store_key, f.product_key, f.week_ending_date, f.closing_value
  FROM fact_stock_week f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE s.region = 'West'
    AND f.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-23' AND DATE '2026-03-22'
),
weekly AS (
  SELECT p.category, st.week_ending_date, sum(st.closing_value) AS week_value
  FROM stock st JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = st.product_key
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 11 AS fiscal_period, 'West' AS region, category,
       round(avg(week_value), 2) AS avg_stock_value_eur
FROM weekly GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
